name: Igoudar Dakhla Green Data Center
developer: Moroccan Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform; Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development; Dakhla-Oued Eddahab regional authorities; Mohammed VI Investment Fund; CDG and public/private partners
actual_country: MA (Dakhla, Western Sahara - disputed territory, Morocco-administered)
note: Moroccan sovereign project located in Dakhla, which lies in the Western Sahara territory (ISO 3166-1 EH) administered by Morocco since 1976. Declared MA matches the universal media/government attribution, but a strict sovereign-country audit would flag the disputed territory. Not a geographic mislocation per se.

name: Google Christmas Island connectivity hub / reported AI data centre

Project reported but not confirmed by Google.

note: Facility is in Macau SAR, which is part of China, so declared CN is not geographically wrong.
